name: noir-interrogation
title_zh: 审问式追问，直到你交出真需求
tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人，而扮演那个嫌疑人的模型自己也不知道那是假的。
why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本，这个设计就作废了。
limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.
title_en: Interrogation-style questioning until real needs surface
